target: a one-file build prompt for a local business website

met: Narrowed the broad topic to a concrete subject (Tannery Row Cycles, Kirkstall, Leeds) and derived a 'job tag' builder concept from it

The skill's template tells the model to forbid changes to invented business details, which conflicts with marking them as placeholders for the owner to replace
